facts.fact: SIFEC is developed by the Agence congolaise des systèmes d'information (ACSI), a public administrative establishment, to a specification it received, its project head told the National Assembly's Ecofin committee; the session was reported on 11 August 2026 as held recently, so the date is the article's.

SIFEC's project head told deputies that the system automates ten civil status events, the main ones being births, marriages and deaths, each ending in a civil status act, alongside centralisation of data and interoperability with other systems; the committee's chair described the applications as being developed. Dated to the article of 11 August 2026.

systems.tiers: under development; aim is the computerisation of the national civil status system
